title: Genuine plain-response 200/201 mismatch
source:
@tag("QuotaInformation")
  @Azure.Core.useFinalStateVia("original-uri")
  createOrUpdate is ArmResourceCreateOrReplaceAsync<
    CurrentQuotaLimitBase,
    QuotaPutBaseParam,
    Response =
      | ArmResourceUpdatedResponse<CurrentQuotaLimitBase>
      | ArmCreatedResponse<
          QuotaRequestSubmitResponse201,
          ExtraHeaders = ArmLroLocationHeader<FinalResult = CurrentQuotaLimitBase> &
            Azure.Core.Foundations.RetryAfterHeader
        >,
    Error = ExceptionResponse
  >;
explanation: Quota intentionally returns the quota resource at 200 and a submission-status envelope at 201, with the final LRO result separately set to the quota resource. The existing Azure Core response-schema-problem visitor detects the initial-payload difference before its explicit authored suppression. Recommend reviewing the legacy exception with that owner, not duplicating it in the ARM rule. Swagger: 1 raw observation; shared ARM rule: 0 corresponding findings.
